source: 616 “Love”
target: 616 “Amor”

source: For a moment, Flores found himself captivated by her presence.
target: Paulisper Flores se ab eius praesentia fascinatum invenit.

source: He couldn’t resist leaning in to compliment her straightforwardly, a habit common among male Feynapotterians.
target: Non potuit resistere inclinandi ut eam directe laudaret, mos viri Feynapotterianorum eum impulsum.

source: “Today is my lucky day to encounter such a beautiful lady.
target: «Hodie mihi dies fortunatus est ut talem pulcherrimam feminam occurrem.

source: Could I be luckier to buy you a drink?”
target: Fortuniorne possum esse, ut tibi potum emam?»

source: The woman’s eyes flickered, and a smile graced her lips.
target: Oculi mulieris micaverunt, et risus labris eius ornatus est.

source: She gently shook her head, indicating that his offer wasn’t accepted.
target: Illa leniter caput movit, demonstrans oblationem eius non acceptam esse.

source: Undeterred, Flores wanted to say more, but he noticed the woman’s expression cooling off, prompting him to retreat to his seat.
target: Non deterritus, Flores plura dicere voluit, sed animadvertebat vultum mulieris refrigerari, quod eum ad sedendum recedere impulit.

source: In the following moments, he alternated between stealing glances at the woman’s figure, clad in a simple shirt and slender black pants, and observing the rim of her glass, watching it touched by her moist red lips.
target: In momentis sequentibus alternē furtivos intuitus in figuram mulieris — induta simplici tunica et tenuissimis nigrīs bracae — et vigilantem contemplationem ad marginem vitrei, quo labia eius rubra umida attingebant.

source: Flores’s body heated up, and his mouth grew dry.
target: Corpus Flores calefaciebatur, et os eius aridum fiebat.

source: The more beer he drank, the harder it became to quench his thirst.
target: Quo plus cerevisiam biberat, eo difficilius fiebat sitim eius exstinguere.

source: Eventually, the woman finished her light-gold Manzan, placed the tall glass on the bar counter, and gracefully left amid the soothing and elegant music.
target: Postremo, mulier Manzan leviter auream finivit, altum vitrum in mensa tabernae posuit, et gratanter discessit inter musicam suavem atque elegantem.

source: Flores hurriedly approached, pulling out a soft tissue that had gained popularity in recent years.
target: Flores festinanter accessit, extrahens mollis linteum, quod annis recentibus favorem adeptum habebat.

source: He wiped the edge of the wine glass, where the woman’s lips had just touched.
target: Os vitrei purgavit, quo labia mulieris modo tetigerant.

source: Then, he folded the tissue, meticulously scanning the surroundings of the bar stool.
target: Deinde linteum convolvit et diligenter circumstantia subsellii tabernae perquirens inspectavit.

source: He collected a few flaxen-colored long hairs, securing them in the tissue.
target: Aliquot capillos longos flavos collegit, eos in linteo retinens.

source: Completing this task, Flores became aware of the bartender and the nearly twenty male customers around him, all staring with a shared judgmental gaze: “Pervert!”
target: Hoc munus perfunctus, Flores animadvertit tabernarium et fere viginti clientes viriles circa se, quī omnes aspectu iudiciali intuēbantur: “Perversus!”

source: Flores wasn’t the sole victim of the woman’s enchantment—it extended to all the men and a few women in the bar.
target: Flores non solus incantationis mulieris capti erat; ipsa influēns erat in omnes virōs et aliquās feminas tabernae.

source: All of them had witnessed his perverted actions.
target: Omnēs eius actiones perversās conspexerant.

source: Despite the accusatory stares, Flores kept his composure and left as if nothing had transpired.
target: Quamquam intuitus accusatoribus erant, Flores se compendium servavit et discessit, quasi nihil accideret.

source: He vowed never to return to this bar again!
target: Iuravit numquam ad hanc tabernam iterum redire!

source: Yet, he harbored no regret for his actions.
target: Attamen, nullam paenitentiam pro factis suis gerebat.

source: On the way back to the apartment, Flores’s heart pulsed with anticipation, fueled by the promise of gains.
target: In itinere ad habitationem redeundum, cor Flores exspectatione palpitatum sentiebat, spe lucri fovente.

source: His pace quickened, though practicality dictated a more measured speed.
target: Cursus eius acceleratus est, quamquam ratio celeritatem moderatam imperabat.

source: Upon reaching his residence, he drew the curtains and retrieved an old notebook with a yellowed cover from his suitcase compartment.
target: Ad domum perveniens, velamina trahebat et veterem libellum cum operculo flavido ex compartimento sarcini sui extraxit.

source: Inside, a mottled note held a complex vocabulary that didn’t belong to any language from the Northern Continent, accompanied by numerous instructions in Highlander.
target: Intra, libellus notā maculātā verba complexa continebat, quae cuiquam linguā Continenti Septentrionalis nequam erant, cum plurimīs praeceptīs in lingua Highlander comitātīs.

source: Flores eagerly placed the tissue containing the woman’s hair and saliva on the notebook.
target: Flores avidē linteum, quod capillos et saliva mulieris continebat, in libello posuit.

source: He then took up the mottled note, reciting the intricate and peculiar words with marked pronunciation.
target: Deinde notam maculātam sustulit, verba intricata et insueta cum distincta pronuntiātiōne recitāns.

source: “Naboredisley…”
target: “Naboredisley…”

source: This was the love incantation Flores had chanced upon.
target: Haec erat incantātiō amoris, quam Flores fortūte invenit.

source: With the true name, date of birth, closely related items, or bodily fluids like flesh and blood, he could insert the medium in his notebook and recite the incantation seven times, compelling the target to fall irrevocably in love.
target: Vero nomine, die natali, rebus cognātīs aut fluidīs corporis ut caro et sanguis, medietātem in libello suo inserere poterat et incantātiōnem septies recitare, cogēns ut destināta in amōre īrrēvocābile incideret.

source: Flores had patiently waited for the opportune moment to orchestrate Pedro’s daughter, Salah, to fall and be injured.
target: Flores patienter exspectāverat opportunum momentum, ut filiam Pedri, Salah, in amōrem incidere atque laedi fieri posset.

source: His timely aid had not only garnered gratitude but also facilitated the collection of her blood, fulfilling the conditions for the love incantation.
target: Auxilium eius tempestīvum non solum gratiam excitāvit, sed etiam sanguinem eius colligere facilitāvit, ita condiciōnēs incantātiōnis amoris complēns.

source: Reality had validated the enchanting power of the love incantation!
target: Rēs ipsa potentiam magicam incantātiōnis amoris confirmāvit!

source: Flores refrained from using it again, uncertain of how to dispel its effects.
target: Flores ne id iterum adhibēret abstinuit, nescius quō modō effectūs eius dissipārentur.

source: If pursued by multiple women before his marriage to Salah, provoking a conflict among them could jeopardize his standing within the large family and hinder access to resources and support.
target: Si ante nuptias cum Salah ab plurimīs feminīs sectūs esset, inter eas controversiā excitāta, statum eius in magna familia periclitāre atque aditus ad subsidia impedīre posset.

source: However, today was different.
target: Tamen hodie prorsus aliud erat.

source: She was the most captivating woman he had ever encountered.
target: Illa erat femina maxime fascināns quam umquam occursus esset eius.

source: He was ready to pay any price to make her his own!
target: Paratus erat pretium qualibet solvere, ut eam sibi assequeretur!

source: Uncertainty lingered in Flores’s mind about whether the saliva-stained tissue and the naturally fallen hair could truly serve as a medium for the love incantation, but the desire to find out overwhelmed any reservations.
target: Dubitatio in mente Flores manēbat, utrum linteum salīva tinctum et capillus naturaliter lapsus vere medietātem incantātiōnis amoris praestāre possent, sed desiderium explorandi omnibus cunctātīs superābat.

source: Excitement and anticipation surged within him as he envisioned the possibility of witnessing such a beautiful scene, an uncontrollable smile gracing his face.
target: Exsultātiō et exspectātiō in eo erumpere coeperunt, dum possibilitātem talis pulcherrimae scaenae videndi imagināret, cum risū inexsuperabili faciem eius ornante.

source: “Naboredisley…”
target: “Naboredisley…”

source: Flores continued reciting the love incantation with abnormal devotion and enthusiasm, his heart pulsating with desire and joy.
target: Flores incantātiōnem amoris cum devōtione et fervōre insuetā recitāre pergebat, cor eius desideri et gaudi pulsāns.

source: “Naboredisley!”
target: “Naboredisley!”

source: After repeating it seven times, Flores watched in amazement as the tissue and hair burst into flames, reflecting a rainbow before swiftly turning to ashes.
target: Postquam eam septies iterāvit, Flores stupēns aspexit linteum et capillos in flammās erumpere, arcum pluviālem repraesentantes, antequam celeriter in cinerem redirent.

source: Success… Success! Flores couldn’t initially believe it, but immense joy struck his heart.
target: Successus… Successus! Flores initīā non credidit, sed immensus gaudiō cor eius percussit.

source: Surprise lingered, but Flores cared little.
target: Mirātiō manēbat, sed Flores parum curābat.

source: What mattered was that it worked!
target: Quod refert, est quod id efficāvit!

source: That captivating woman is now in love with me!
target: Illa fascināns femina nunc in me amōre infixa est!

source: Thoughts of what would unfold next raced through Flores’s mind.
target: Cogitātiōnēs de futurīs eveniendīs per mentem Flores rapide volitāvērunt.

source: He hastily closed the notebook, clipped the note, and dashed to the door without bothering to put them away.
target: Libellum festinanter clausit, notam alligavit, atque ad ianuam celeriter accessit—haec omne reponere non instanter cogitāns.

source: He yearned to walk the streets, confident that the lovely person must be seeking him!
target: Cupībat per vīās ambulāre, certus quod pulcherrima persona eum quaerere dēbet!

source: As Flores swung the door open, there she was—the woman from the bar, standing outside.
target: Dum Flores ianuam pandēbat, ecce—illa, mulier ex taberna, extra stans.

source: Flores’s entire being went slack under the lake-colored crystalline gaze, his balance teetering on the edge of surrender.
target: Totum esse Flores languide cecidit sub aspectu crystallino colore lacūs, aequilibrium eius in limine deditionis vacillans.

source: Every fiber of his being yearned to yield.
target: Omnis fibra eius se concedere desiderabat.

source: As the woman willingly stepped into Flores’s embrace, he eagerly enveloped her in his arms, leaning in for a kiss.
target: Cum mulier libenter in amplexum Flores intrāvit, ille ea cupidē in brachiis complexus ad osculum inclinābat.

source: Yet, the sensation he encountered was far from the warmth and softness he had imagined.
target: Sed sensus quem percepit longe dissimulabat ab calōre et teneritāte quae imagināverat.

source: Instead, it was cold and unyielding.
target: Immo, frigidus erat et inexorābilis.

source: Wh… Flores’s surprise turned to shock as he realized he was embracing a waist-high mirror.
target: Quid… Stupor Flores in īnclīnātum pertransformatus est, cum animadvertit se speculum ad lumborum altitudinem amplecti.

source: The mirror brushed against his chest, swaying back and forth, resisting his attempts to disengage.
target: Speculum pectus eius leniter contrectāvit, huc illuc fluctuans, conātīs eius se liberandi repugnans.

source: Flores recoiled in unnatural fear.
target: Flores in timōre innātō contrāvērit.

source: The lingering sensations from his earlier fantasies refused to dissipate.
target: Sensationēs permanentes ex phantasiīs prīoribus dissolvere noluērunt.

source: His heart froze while his body burned.
target: Cor eius condenserat, dum corpus ardebātur.

source: With mounting dread, he struck the mirror with increasing force.
target: Cum metu crescente, speculum vi auctā percussit.

source: Finally, retreating to his suitcase, Flores delivered a decisive blow, shattering the mirror with a resounding crack.
target: Postremo, ad sarcinam revertus, Flores ictum dēcisīvus dedit, speculum fragore resonante confractum.

source: It shattered into countless fragments, piercing Flores’s clothes, chest, stomach, and arms.
target: Speculum in innumerābilēs fragmenta concidit, vestimenta eius, pectus, venter, ac brachia perforans.

source: Agony surged through Flores’s body, searing his senses, snapping the fraying nerve that was already on the brink.
target: Agōnia per corpus Flores diffundebat, sensūs eius flagrant, nervum iam labōrem ad finem tendentem rumpēns.

source: In that moment, he tasted a euphoria unlike any other.
target: In illo momento saporem laetītiānis incomparābilis degustāvit.

source: Collapsing to the ground, Flores lay motionless, caught between fear, longing, anguish, and ecstasy.
target: Terram corruens, Flores immotus iacebat, inter timōrem, desiderium, cruciātum, et extāsium captus.

source: “It can truly assist in digesting the Pleasure potion…” Franca clicked her tongue, observing the scene unfold in the mirror of the apartment diagonally opposite Flores’s room.
target: «Vere potest auxiliārī in digestiōne potionis Voluptātis…» Franca lingua crepuit, spectāns scaenam in speculō habitationis angulō opposītā ad conclāvem Flores evolvere.

source: With her expertise, the spectacle before her could be deemed a novelty.
target: Per artēs suās, spectaculum ante eam novitātem dīcī potuit.

source: “I assured you I wouldn’t deceive you,” Lumian, sporting a golden straw hat, responded with a grin.
target: «Te certiōrem feci me nōn te falliturum esse,» respondit Lumian, gerens pileum aureum straminis, cum risū.

source: Upon accepting the commission and identifying Flores’s primary problem of inexplicably garnering the fervent affection of a stunning girl, Lumian’s initial instinct was to deploy a Demoness to test this individual.
target: Commissionem suscipiens et prīmam problemāticam Flores, scilicet inexplicābiliter ardorem amōris ab puellā stupendā accipiendi, dēprehendens, prīma eius instinctus erat daemonessam ad hunc hominem probandum mittere.

source: Franca’s saliva and hair served as part of the investigation. After all, mysticism likely played a role.
target: Salīva et capillī Francae partem investigationis erant. Post omnia, mystica fortasse partem egit.

source: Naturally, for safety precautions, Franca had treated the saliva and hair beforehand. Thus, she devised a Mirror Substitution, a dark magic of Witches, which accurately connected to them.
target: Naturaliter, ad cautelam, Franca salīvam ac capillōs praeviē curāvit. Itaque Speculī Substitutionem excogitāvit, magiam tenebrōsam strigarum, quae ad eōs exacte alligāta erat.

source: Now, the results were in—splendid. Franca had subjected Flores to pleasure’s torment, exposing him to the agony of chasing fleeting satisfaction.
target: Iam eventus erant—splendidī! Franca Flores ad tormentum voluptātis subiecit, eum ad cruciātum persequendi satisfactionis evanidae exponēns.

source: “Curious, Flores managed to ensnare my mirror’s affection with just a single-word incantation. No ritual or supplication to any entity,” Franca mused with emotion. “Even I can’t achieve that.”
target: «Curiosum est: Flores solō verbō incantātiōnis speculī meī amōrem capere potuit—nec ritu nec supplicātiōne cuiusquam entitātis adhibita,» meditāta dixit Franca cum mōtū. «Etiam ego id adipisci nōn possum.»

source: Lumian chuckled in response, remarking, “You can. No incantation or medium needed. Just unleash your charm.”
target: Lumian subridens respondit, «Possis; nulla incantātiō neque medium requīritur—tantum tuam venustātem effunde.»

source: “…” Franca was taken aback. “You’re starting to resemble an Intisian. Or is this a result of your Feynapotter education?”
target: «…» Obstupefacta, Franca exclamāvit: «Incipis instar Intisianī esse; an haec ex educatione tua Feynapotteriana provenit?»

source: Pursing her lips, her gaze flickered.
target: Labris contrahendīs, aspectus eius micāvit.

source: Lumian continued, “There’s another issue. Pedro previously tasked two adventurers with probing Flores, but they vanished. And it appears this fellow lacks Beyonder powers.”
target: Lumian pergebat: «Altera quaestiō est. Pedrum olim duo explorātōrēs ad Flores indagandum prōvīderunt, sed evanuerunt; et vidētur hic vir carēre viribus Beyonder.»

source: Franca suddenly smiled. “This is intriguing… If the Mirror Substitution failed, and I fell under the sway of that incantation, falling in love with Flores, what would you do?”
target: Subitā subrīdens Franca dixit: «Hoc mirum est… Si Speculī Substitutio defecisset, et ego sub imperiō incantātiōnis illae caderer, Flores in amōrem incidens, quid fēcissem?»

source: Lumian emitted a soft chuckle.
target: Lumian risum levem edidit.

source: “Making someone vanish without a trace is simple. I don’t even need to lift a finger.”
target: «Aliquem sine vestigiō evanescere facile est; ne digito quidem levāre mihi opus est.»

source: Lumian was confident Ludwig could consume the fellow entirely, with counter-divination to top it off.
target: Lumian confidēbat Ludovicum posse totum illum hominem devorāre, cum contradivinātiōne additā.

source: Without awaiting Franca’s response, Lumian headed for the door.
target: Nōn exspectāns responsum Francae, Lumian ad ianuam se contulit.

source: “I’ll pay that fellow a visit. Keep vigilant for any developments and beware of mishaps.”
target: «Ille hominem visitābō; vigilātea in quālibet novitāte et cave casus.»

source: “Understood,” Franca replied solemnly.
target: «Intellectum,» respondit Franca sollemniter.

source: As Flores hadn’t managed to close the door in time, Lumian found the entrance accessible without the need to pry it open.
target: Quōrum Flores non in tempore ianuam claudere potuit, Lumian ostium facile invenit, sine eo aperiendum.

source: Sensing the intrusion, Flores snapped out of his daze, hastily rising to his feet.
target: Intrūsiōnem sentiens, Flores ex stupefactiōne evigilavit, celeriter ad pedēs surgēns.

source: By this point, Lumian had already picked up the notebook, unfolding it to the two pages displaying the mottled note.
target: Hoc tempore, Lumian iam libellum sustulit, id explicāns ad duas páginas quae notam maculātam ostendēbant.

source: “W-what are you doing?” Flores asked, horror etched across his face.
target: «Q-quid facis?» inquit Flores, terrore vultū eius notāto.

source: He immediately recognized Lumian.
target: Statim Lumian agnovit.

source: Louis Berry? The great adventurer Louis Berry?
target: Louis Berry? Magnus explorātōr Louis Berry?

source: “Did Pedro hire you to investigate me?”
target: «Num Pedrum te ad me indagandum constituit?»

source: Ignoring the inquiry, Lumian walked toward the window, ushering in a gust of fresh air.
target: Quaestiōnem neglexit, Lumian versus fenestram ambulāvit, afferens recentem aērem.

source: “A love incantation can make a woman fall in love with you. All you need is to obtain her true name…” Lumian began reciting the Highlander annotation on the mottled note in front of Flores.
target: «Incantātiō amoris potest facere ut femina in te incidat; omnē quod opus est, verum nōmen eius adipisci…» Lumian incipiebat recitare annotātiōnem Highlander in notā maculātā ante Flores.

source: “The incantation’s pronunciation is…”
target: «Pronuntiātiō incantātiōnis est…»

source: He abruptly halted without completing the recitation.
target: Repentinus cessāvit, recitiōnem non complēns.

source: Flores’s face had already turned a sickly grayish-white, as if he could foresee the impending demise of his reputation and his capture by the Church.
target: Faciēs Flores iam in pallidum grisium albo deceptive versa erat, tamquam exitium famae suae ac Ecclesiae captūrā imminere praevidēret.

source: “Where did this come from?” Lumian pointed at the mottled note and the old notebook.
target: «Unde hoc ortum est?» inquit Lumian, notam maculātam et veterem libellum demonstrāns.

source: Cold sweat broke out on Flores’s forehead, and his eyes gradually turned fierce.
target: Sudor frigidus in fronte Flores effusus est, et oculī eius paulatim acerrimī factī sunt.

source: Suddenly, he shouted, pronouncing the word in a rugged and awkward tone, “Naboredisley!”
target: Subitō clamāvit, verbum in tono rūdī et ineptō pronuntiāns: «Naboredisley!»

source: This time, there was no target or corresponding medium.
target: Hoc tempore neque destinātum neque medium congruum aderat.

source: Almost simultaneously, Lumian sensed his surroundings fall silent as an ominous aura rapidly enveloped the room.
target: Prope simul, Lumian sensit circumstantiās silentium referre, dum aura ominōsa conclāvem celeriter involvit.
